_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score and tape are coiled dead-center in Complacency with no breaker; base-rate supports skilled HOLD until momentum or funding leaves the 40-60/flat band.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is Complacency/HOLD; narrative only restates Hope with no forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d stays inside +/-3%, momentum 40-60, funding near flat, fear/greed 50-70
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum exits 40-60 with range break (above 70 + rising funding → Disbelief, or fear/greed <45 + VIX expand → Anxiety)
